baseline_v1.scope: Previously validated functional reproduction baseline. Phase 2 has its own milestones and does not revise the v1 ledger.

contract.controller: The same controller for all four tasks.
contract.learning_order: N03 / N12 first; add N17 / N18 after Me.

earlier_expert_reliability.scope: Existing scripted experts under the original CPU physics settings; 20 fixed pose-bank seeds per task. No training or expert optimization.
earlier_expert_reliability.seed_policy: All planned cases count, including planning failures. No retries or replacement.

distribution.N03: Original SE(2) family: x 0.30–0.40 m, y −0.46–−0.28 m, yaw ±45°.
distribution.N12_N17_N18: Nominal source (0.35, −0.40) m with independent x/y ±20 mm and yaw ±30°; roll/pitch fixed at zero.

earlier_expert_reliability.disclosure: Summary verified against local result artifacts. Raw measurement artifacts are not published with this page.

milestones.title: Shared load & controller tracking
milestones.scope: Measure throughput at 16 / 64 / 256 parallel environments under shared load; check tracking with the same controller.
milestones.acceptance: Record measured throughput and controller tracking before selecting the rollout configuration.
milestones.result_note: Partial: 16 environments measured 877.744721 env-steps/s and 0.4571587 sim/wall under shared load (5 s load sampling); a 30.01069 s memory calibration observed M16 = 4,931 MiB. The 64 / 256 batches never started (0 launches): required free memory was 29,586 / 118,344 MiB versus 15,485 MiB at admission; their values remain null. B1 completed one 30-native-second free-space diagnostic across 16 Panda worlds. Actual tracking gates all passed: worst-world position RMS 4.1217 mm / max 6.0730 mm; orientation RMS 0.81688° / max 1.25805°. Command and actual speed/acceleration exceedances were all zero; acceleration limiting occurred on 50,142 / 403,200 joint-steps (12.4%), with zero speed limiting. The clock recorded 3,600 callbacks / 30.000001565 s; wall time was 529.614 s. The original full FD gate remains false at far-origin x≈22 / 30 m in float32; all three earlier failures are retained. This is an independently passed trajectory diagnostic, not a full controller-gate pass or a learning result.

milestones.title: State-driven, re-entrant experts
milestones.scope: Start with N03 / N12. Each expert must resume from the current observed state rather than depend on a one-way script.
milestones.acceptance: Centered 4×4 task domain: pass a native TCP Jacobian preflight at the same thresholds first; then 20 nominal episodes and 50 real mid-trajectory rollout-state takeover tests per task. State-driven experts must match prior nominal success before takeover.
milestones.result_note: N03 candidate 1 completed 0/20 nominal tasks; all attempts remain recorded. No takeover test or learning has started. Centered-scene preflights passed on local N03 and remote N12; an evidence-based expert correction is being prepared.

milestones.title: One vector environment & verifier
milestones.scope: Unify the vector environment, trajectory records and stage-wise verifier across the four Panda tasks.
milestones.acceptance: Shared observation/action contract; saved trajectories; explicit verifier admission and rejection records.
milestones.result_note: Unified rollout and verifier acceptance not yet measured.

milestones.title: Qualify a recoverable challenge
milestones.scope: Expand pose ranges by 50%; add 2–3 cm object pushes, slip events and 30 ms observation delay.
milestones.acceptance: Expert success ≥85% and single-task BC with 20 demonstrations ≤60%. At most two difficulty adjustments.
milestones.result_note: Challenge qualification not yet measured; the earlier CPU pose-bank results do not satisfy this gate.

milestones.title: Matched policy learning & ablations
milestones.scope: Compare M0–M4 with the same network, matched expert-label budgets and three seeds. Run two OPD ablations.
milestones.acceptance: Complete the N03 / N12 comparison before adding N17 / N18 to learning. Report all planned evaluation metrics.
milestones.result_note: No trained-policy comparison or learning curve reported.

milestones.title: Reconnect student skills to C01
milestones.scope: Integrate the learned student skills into the existing C01 closed loop.
milestones.acceptance: Evaluate the integrated student workflow and its failure recovery; retain the original C01 evidence separately.

methods.name: Oracle
methods.role: Oracle reference; report separately from learned policies.

methods.name: Multi-task BC
methods.role: Behavioral cloning from the matched expert-label budget.

methods.name: OPD (user method)
methods.role: Student rollout → task-expert labels → sample/label-validity verifier filter → failure/recovery weighting → K rounds. Verified failure/recovery segments may be admitted; episode success is not the admission criterion.

opd_loop: Verifier filter for sample / label validity

evaluation.name: First-attempt success
evaluation.protocol: At least 50 episodes per task and method; report numerator, denominator and 95% Wilson interval.

evaluation.name: Failure recovery
evaluation.protocol: Report recovery from the declared pushes, slips and observation delay.

evaluation.name: Attempts 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 + slope
evaluation.protocol: Report success by attempt and improvement slope. Keep frozen-weight evaluation separate from test-time updates.

evaluation.name: Expert-label budget
evaluation.protocol: Plot measured performance against expert-label budget for each matched method.

evaluation.name: Verifier admission / rejection
evaluation.protocol: Report sample/label-validity admission and rejection, denominators and reasons. Verified failure/recovery segments may enter weighted learning; admission does not mean episode success.

disclosures: This page describes the approved phase-2 plan and a dated local evidence summary.
A completed expert reliability measurement does not establish learned-policy performance, recovery capability or a phase-2 milestone pass.
No OPD learning curves or policy success scores have been measured in this snapshot.

Actual B1 trajectory tracking passed independently of the still-false original full local FD gate. Three precheck failures remain retained; centered-domain FD preflight is required before Mb task episodes. No learning has been run.

throughput.memory_extrapolation: M(n) = M16 × n / 16, including fixed application overhead; require fresh free memory ≥ 1.5 × M(n).
throughput.scope: Single-run GPU-physics timing under shared load: 100 warmup + 1000 timed prefix steps; the 16-env run continues for a 30-second memory calibration. Environment-steps/s is not completed tasks/s or learned-policy throughput.

reference_probe.diagnosis: COM/link reference-point mismatch confirmed; actual COM-offset correction reduces linear-column error to 0.07–0.10 mm/rad.
reference_probe.next_step: COM-reference correction used in the tracking diagnostic; centered-domain native FD preflight still required for Mb.

controller_B1.full_gate_limitation: The original full finite-difference gate remains false at far-origin x≈22 / 30 m in float32. Actual trajectory tracking passes independently; no FD threshold or controller gain was relaxed.
controller_B1.next_step: Mb centered 4×4 task domain requires a native TCP Jacobian preflight with the same thresholds before task episodes.
controller_B1.scope: One 30-native-second free-space diagnostic across 16 Panda worlds. It does not establish task success, contact skills, general workspace reliability or learned-policy performance.

shared_load_calibration.scope: Different runtime configuration; this is not a matched performance comparison with the primary TRX node.

CPU_N03_functional_smoke.scope: One same-seed functional smoke, not an expert reliability estimate.

verifier_admission.meaning: Sample and expert-label validity; not equivalent to episode success.
verifier_admission.failure_recovery_segments: Verified failure and recovery segments may enter weighted learning.
